_pipeline: For new own photos: save the EXIF-stripped full-res original to /workspace/crystopedia-book/own-photos/<name>.jpg, then run /workspace/.rawenv/bin/python scripts/own_photo_studio.py <that file> studio|crop|keep [l,t,r,b crop fractions]. 'studio' uses rembg to swap distracting backgrounds for a soft neutral gradient with a soft shadow and a tight crop. Use 'crop' for hand-held shots and 'keep' for nice natural scenes. Originals are kept as *-orig.jpg (book and web). The script writes the 1600px web copy and the 480px -sm thumb to src/assets/own/.
